277-2893-3470-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Lotus Cobra and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

6871-6879-7298-7369.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Oxidda Daredevil by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Oxidda Daredevil ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4295-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Powerstone Shard.
Activate a Powerstone Shard by tapping it, adding {C} for each Powerstone Shard you control.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Powerstone Shard.
Activate two Powerstone Shards by tapping them, adding {C}{C} for each Powerstone Shard you control.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 infinitely.
4295-7282.notes: The mana cost assumes you control one untapped Powerstone Shard as you begin the combo. If Powerstone Shard is tapped or you control more than one, the mana cost will change.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-7296.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

245-1069-4460-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-4460-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

5641-6012-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
5641-6012-7096.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-3490-4476-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4476-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

539-5686-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

290-585-3767-3918.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Dreamstone Hedron's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2783-5413-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-6593-6627.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and The Earth Crystal.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-6593-6627.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-1283-6259-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-5558-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1170-1171-1753.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

2061-2493-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
2061-2493-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2464-4687-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
2464-4687-4893.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

602-1742-1957.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one creature card in hand.
602-1742-1957.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a creature card, adding {B}.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return any creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1424-1496-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
1424-1496-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar and gaining you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

2050-3525-3620.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Gift of Paradise attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-3620.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Gift of Paradise, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.
